note: Expands Mermaid source into one editable PowerPoint group (p:grpSp), returning /slide[N]/group[K]. Native offline support covers flowchart/graph TD/TB/LR/RL and common rectangle/rounded/ellipse/diamond/hexagon nodes with directed links, plus sequenceDiagram participants, lifelines, solid/dashed messages and labels. Advanced directives, browser image rendering and C#'s full crossing-reduction/router remain pending.

width.description: Reserved for C# compatibility; native PPTX flowchart currently uses its natural group size.
